field_density.note: WWOX with white matter is sparse (6 records). No independent infant-MRI GWAS replication of rs10514437 was found in this reading; the paper itself reports the SNP absent from both comparison cohorts.

entries.proposition: The WWOX intronic SNP did not reach the study’s own genome-wide threshold for white matter volume.
entries.snippet: An intronic SNP in WWOX (rs10514437) fell just short of genome-wide significance for WM

entries.proposition: The study threshold is a Bonferroni division of the conventional threshold by four phenotypes.
entries.snippet: were considered genome-wide significant (Bonferroni correction for four MRI phenotypes

entries.proposition: rs10514437 is directly genotyped, not imputed.
entries.snippet: Note that all SNPs are imputed with the exception of rs10514437

entries.proposition: A1 in Table 1 is the effect allele; the per-allele difference is effect size over mean volume.
entries.snippet: A1 is the effective allele and A2 is the reference allele. Diff./allele is the ratio of effect size over mean brain volume.

entries.proposition: The adolescent and adult cohorts are not a replication sample, by the authors’ statement.
entries.snippet: These comparisons do not represent a conventional replication sample.

entries.proposition: The authors call for independent replication.
The link to white matter is an interpretation resting on cited adult WOX1 expression, not on a measurement in this study.
entries.snippet: are high in neuronal axons and nerve bundles such as corpus callosum and striatal fascicles

entries.proposition: Supplementary Table 10 reports no PNC and no ENIGMA2 value for rs10514437 (NA): it was not tested in either comparison cohort.
